text:
noah: Heads up — eu-west dedicated GPU pool 3 has hit 100% allocation and queue depth spiked. Scheduler returning a lot of 'insufficient resources' errors. Hosted fallback didn't ramp as expected.

alina: Is this a steady ramp or a sudden spike? Any specific orgs causing it?

cheng: Sudden. Saw a burst from org=studio-creative around 08:18 UTC, ~2.4k concurrent sessions with many long-context requests. Pod evictions started ~08:23 UTC.

k8s-bot: Event: PodEvicted - node=gpu-eu-03 - reason=OutOfResources - pod=redwood-dedicated-inference-7f9b6

deploy-bot: Fallback policy fired for pool "eu-west-dedicated": automatic weight shift -> hosted (initial percent=30).

ryan_oncall: I'm doing a manual weight shift to buy time. Running commands now.

ryan_oncall: ```
# increase hosted weight and pause low-priority acceptance
infra-cli route update --pool eu-west-dedicated --hosted-weight +50
infra-cli pool pause-accepting --pool eu-west-dedicated --priority low
```

maria: What's the ballpark cost impact if hosted absorbs ~50% of traffic today?

costbot: Cost estimate: +$4.8k/day if 50% of traffic shifts to hosted with current model mix and token rates. (Estimate based on last 7d averages)

noah: Agreed we should prioritize throttling low-priority orgs first. Cross-region siphoning from us-west is possible but adds latency and egress.

alina: Opening a capacity ticket to bump dedicated pool and to tune the autoscaler thresholds. Assigning to infra-scaling.

cheng: Warming up hosted replicas to avoid cold-start latency. Kicking synthetic traffic + prefix cache warmups.

cheng: ```
# warmup script (short prompts, repeated prefixes)
for i in 1..200:
  http post https://hosted.redwood/api/generate {prompt: "hi"} 
```

k8s-bot: Cluster autoscaler: requested 6 new GPU nodes for eu-west-dedicated. Expected ready ~12m.

ryan_oncall: Monitoring: if avg latency doesn't drop below 250ms within 20m we'll escalate to full hosted weight and start org-level throttles for studio-creative.

maria: :thumbsup: Also tagging cost center for studio-creative and flagging them for temporary rate limits.

noah: Created incident ticket INT-2026-282. Owner: alina. Initial actions: capacity bump, autoscaler tuning, fallback cooldown tuning, org throttles.

cheng: Adding a protective rule: don't let automated fallback exceed 60% hosted unless p95 latency >500ms for 5m continuously.

ryan_oncall: Current p95 latency = 310ms and trending down. Queue depth reduced by ~45% after weight shift and warmup. Will watch for 2 hours.

alina: Follow-ups: (1) repro of studio-creative burst pattern, (2) scheduling dedicated capacity add next maintenance window, (3) update runbook to make fallback cooldown configurable by pool.

noah: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread. If we see another spike, we escalate to exec oncall.
